user.title: Track manga releases
user.description: Search the local manga metadata database and choose the release lines to track. Filters are populated from values available in the database.

select.title: Select release lines
select.description: Different countries, languages and publishers may have separate release lines.

calendars.title: Calendar
calendars.description:
Choose the release lines to show in the Tsundoku calendar, with one all-day event for each volume that has an exact release date. Leave everything unselected to skip it.

Not available, because their release dates have only a month or a year: {unavailable}

error.select_at_least_one: Select at least one release line.

abort.already_configured: Tsundoku is already configured. Use its options to add or remove manga.

init.title: Manage tracked manga
init.description: Add or remove manga release lines, or choose the ones shown in the calendar.

add_search.title: Search for manga to add
add_search.description: Search the local manga metadata database and choose the release lines to track. Filters are populated from values available in the database.

add_select.title: Select manga to add
add_select.description: Select one or more release lines to add to tracking.

add_calendars.title: Calendar
add_calendars.description:
Choose the new release lines to show in the Tsundoku calendar, with one all-day event for each volume that has an exact release date. Leave everything unselected to skip it.

Not available, because their release dates have only a month or a year: {unavailable}

add_calendars_unavailable.title: Calendar not available

remove.title: Remove tracked manga
remove.description: Select the release lines to stop tracking.

calendars.title: Manage the calendar
calendars.description:
Select the release lines shown in the Tsundoku calendar. Those you unselect are removed from it.

Not available, because their release dates have only a month or a year: {unavailable}

calendars_unavailable.title: Calendar not available
calendars_unavailable.description:
None of your release lines can be in the calendar: their release dates have only a month or a year, without an exact day.

get_releases.name: Get releases
get_releases.description: Returns the volumes releasing in a range of days, with the titles of their manga ready to use in notifications. Volumes dated to a month or a year only are left out.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day of the range. Defaults to today.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days in the range, starting from the start date. Defaults to 1, a single day.

get_upcoming.name: Get upcoming releases
get_upcoming.description: Returns the next volumes to release, from today on, with the titles of their manga ready to use in notifications. Volumes dated to a month or a year only are left out.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of volumes to return. Defaults to 5.

get_month_releases.name: Get month releases
get_month_releases.description: Returns the volumes releasing in a month, including the ones dated to the month only, which have no exact day.

month.name: Month
month.description: The month as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-11. Defaults to the current month.

not_loaded.message: Tsundoku is not loaded. Check the integration in Settings → Devices & services.
